name: A10-0079/2025 – Borys Budka – Article 1, § 1; Regulation (EU) 2017/1938; Article 22, after § 4 – Am 17
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2017/1938 as regards the role of gas storage for securing gas supplies ahead of the winter season
part_text: The definition and implementation of measures to secure gas supply is the exclusive responsibility of the Member States. The European Commission must not impose binding requirements that limit or replace the national energy policies of the Member States.
